serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It won’t hurt to ask him. He lived longer than me and maybe he has some wisdom to share.
You: Hello, sir Landlord. I have a question to ask.
Landlord: ‘Sir Landlord’ hehe~ Now that’s the proper way to address me. Did you finally get a clue and showed me some proper respect?
Landlord: No, wait, wait! Let me take it back.
Landlord: I recognize that pleading tone. You want something. 
Landlord: Every tenant that wants his rent lowered because of some bullshit like ‘times are tough’ or ‘I was fired from a job’ always starts by addressing me by ‘sir’.
Landlord: It’s like they finally found their tongues after years of treating me like air on the streets or even these corridors here, in my own building!
Landlord: So, how about you just get over with your pleas so I can shut you down? I’m a busy man!
You: Y-Yeah, I didn’t want to ask for lowering my rent,
Landlord: Oh. 
Landlord: Now you piqued my interest. 
Landlord: Let me guess! You finally realised how much good I do for this community and you stopped me to ask to have your rent risen! 
You: N-No, that’s not it either.
It seemed like he really meant that… Is he out of his mind? 
I’m beginning to regret starting this conversation.
Landlord: You got me! I have no idea what you want from me!
You: I want to ask for advice.
Landlord: Like, what to invest in or…
You: No.
You: So, there’s this girl…
Landlord: Wha?! {{punch}}
Landlord: You surprised me. That kind of advice…
Landlord: No one ever asked me for something like this, but lucky for you, back in the day I was quite handsome and my rich parents bought me an expensive sports car for my 16th birthday.
Landlord: I was the most popular guy in our school! Good days…
Landlord: Please, continue with your question!
You: Yeah…
You: She works nearby and I learned her secret. I want to talk about it, but I don’t want to appear creepy or scare her out since I want us to be friends.
Landlord: Hmmm… {{wi}}blackmail or hypnotism…
You: What?
Landlord: What?
You: I think you said something.
Landlord: Oh, I was just thinking out loud, don’t think about it.
You: A-Anyway, do you have some advice for a situation like that?
Landlord: Personally, I would have a few ways to approach this, but since you want her to be your sex friend…
You: No, just a friend.
Landlord: Yeah, yeah, I get it. {{wi}}’Friend’ with benefits.
You: …
Landlord: I think it’s impossible for you to become anyone's sex friend. You lack looks, money, poise, everything!
Landlord: I could give you some more morally ambiguous tips, but you seem like a guy with no balls for it. {{wi}}No offence.
You: None taken…
Landlord: You should give up and if you have some dirty little secret on some cutie, feel free to share~ Huehehehehe~
Ugh! What a disgusting laugh…
You: I will think about it…
Landlord: Well, I hope I cleared your doubts and feel free to ask me again!
You: …
